lanes.summary: No in-app account deletion is documented. The privacy policy gives only an email address, and "Fresh start mode" wipes data ("cannot be undone") but is not account deletion.
No official word on offline use; data lives in Firestore (cloud), and one aggregator lists "offline functionality". Unverified.
Frequent release notes in App Store version history (latest 1.34, Jan 13; 1.32 interactive reports, Liquid Glass); no in-app What's New was found.
No AI. Data lives in Firebase Firestore, but no sync or server failure handling is documented; only widget update bugs were fixed (v1.14).

No AI; traced analytics: the privacy policy names PostHog usage analytics and Firestore with consent "By using our Service", no opt-out is described, and the label lists linked data for the developer's marketing.
